outlook.statement: Management remains focused on strengthening operational efficiency, optimizing cost structures, and delivering sustainable long-term value to all stakeholders.

The jewellery industry enters FY2026-27 at an inflection point shaped by global trade developments and evolving consumer expectations. Recent reduction in US tariffs and demand rebound prospects, alongside diversification into UAE, Australia and Hong Kong, provide a more constructive external environment. Sustained gold price volatility and tighter duty-free import framework mean cost management and pricing agility remain critical. Company aims to evolve from retailer to curator of experiences, expand physical footprint in emerging urban/semi-urban centres, focus on innovation rooted in tradition with customisation central, monitor lab-grown diamonds and lighter-weight designs, commit to responsible sourcing and transparent hallmarking, explore digital tools to complement in-store experience, and maintain agility and customer-centricity as guiding principles.
